    34	def _pairs_hook(pairs):
    35	    d = {}
    36	    for k, v in pairs:

    39	        d[k] = v
    40	    return d

    47	def _load_object(text):
    48	    try:

    50	                         parse_constant=_bad_constant)
    51	    except Bad:
    52	        raise
    53	    except Exception:
    54	        raise Bad("bad json")
    55	    if obj.__class__ is not dict:

    60	def _hex_bytes(value):
    61	    if value.__class__ is not str:
    62	        raise Bad("hex not a string")
    63	    if _HEX_RE.fullmatch(value) is None:
    64	        raise Bad("hex charset")
    65	    if len(value) & 1:
    66	        raise Bad("hex odd length")

    70	def _id_str(value):
    71	    if value.__class__ is not str or _ID_RE.fullmatch(value) is None:

    76	def _int_in(value, lo, hi):
